Tenure:
• Judges hold office until the age of 62 years.
Oath is administered by the Governor of the state.

items: Remember that the oath is administered by the Governor of the state (often confused with the President in exams).
High Court Judges hold office until the age of 62 years (unlike Supreme Court judges who hold office until 65).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The oath to a judge is administered by the Governor of the state.
Judges retain their office until reaching the retirement age of 62 years.
